entries.title: Jeremiah 39:1
segments:
vv 1-10. 
 
Though God's threatened judgments be long delayed, they wll come at last upon those who persist in their impenitence; and then the reality will be as terrible as the previous announcement of them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 39:2
segments: The city was broken up; a breach was made in its walls; probably in the northern wall of the lower city, which itself lay north of the upper city or Zion, for this was the side on which Jerusalem was most open to assault.

entries.title: Jeremiah 39:3
segments: The middle gate; probably the gate of the wall which separated the upper city from the lower.

entries.title: Jeremiah 39:4
segments:
The king's garden; in the south-east, near the place where the two valleys of Kedron and Hinnom meet. 
 
  The way of the plain; the way toward the plain of the Jordan.

entries.title: Jeremiah 39:5
segments: Riblah in the land of Hamath; north of Palestine, on the route from that country to Babylon.

entries.title: Jeremiah 39:10
segments: The poor of the people; compare

entries.title: Jeremiah 39:11
segments:
vv 11-14. 
 
In the overthrow of the wicked, God will provide for the safety of his faithful servants who put their trust in him.

entries.title: Jeremiah 39:15
segments:
vv 15-18. 
 
No act of faith and love can escape the notice of Jehovah.  In the present life God will generally reward it openly, and always in the life to come.
